name: Shelloo
title: Tide Shell Turtle
description: Tucks into its teal shell whenever a deploy looks scary.
catchphrase: Retreats safely inside an impenetrable shell whenever exceptions strike.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Crisp sweet romaine lettuce leaf! Shell shines with polished jade! 🥬🐢
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Slowly poking head out of shell, blinking with ancient wisdom! 🐢
companionPersonality.petReaction: Gentle chin rub on wrinkled green neck brings a sweet slow smile! 🐢💖

dialogue.idle: Basking on a warm river log, feet stretched out behind. 🐢
dialogue.working: Withstanding torrential exception storms inside titanium shell! 🐢⚡
dialogue.thinking: Taking all the time in the world to find the right answer... 🤔
dialogue.success: Slow and steady! Won the race while the hare crashed! 🐢🎉
dialogue.error: *thump* Tucking head and limbs into shell until danger passes! 🛡️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... safe and snug inside impenetrable domed shell... 🌙
